notes.title: Update 13052019 "The update"
notes.content:
at last, crazy amount of hours last week on this. so many things have been fixed that i cannot write all of them here.. anyway here it is.. the update.

[b]new/tweaks[/b]

- survivor character replaced and animations redone
- some killer animations redone
- many graphics changes for better visuals
- alot of optimizations around the game, characters, foliage, items, network, everything
- removed killer y-axis animation look because new animation, camera still rotates normally
- added option to ready up at end of match, time will go down 10 seconds per player when at ready state
- collision handling changed in some items, removed useless ones
- survivor field of view (FOV) raised from 100 to 110
- spectators can now move down and up with ctrl and space (this was before there but it is added back now)
- max playercount raised from 7 to 10
- increased brightness
- changed the way game handles achievements

[b]map generation system[/b]

- map generation system highly modified, this system increases network speed, changes map playability and overall looks
- fixes the issue that map generation sometimes made places where items spawned and they could not be reached
- fixes issues on maps where you can go to places where you shouldnt be able to go
- all maps are rebuilt

[b]ui[/b]

- changed the way the game handles UI elements like scoreboards, loading screens, player hud etc..
- every map has their own pictures in loading screen
- many UI updated

[b]sound[/b]

- sound systems redone how they work
- lot of missing and overlapping sounds fixed

[b]networking[/b]

- fixed issues with many sounds and some gameplay mechanics

[b]bugs fixed[/b]

- many codes spawn to same spot
- some in-game UI stay on screen when leaving a game
- both survivor or killer cant vault at very edge of obstacles
- current players on server is 0 at server list
- when connecting to server during end timer cannot see scores, also if game is loading connecting player will see loading screen like everyone else
- killer hits twice as a client
- missing footsteps on some areas
- when setting random level and hosting sometimes it will throw back to main menu
- random map changing mess up the whole game
- some items do not have any hit sound when killer hits into it
- wrong map showing on serverlist when playing random levels

if you find bugs i appreciate it alot if you write in the bug reports discussion about it.
when finding a bug: what happened? what you did before that or what you were going to do when bug happened? did the bug happen for server maker or others?
the more information about the situation more easier the bug is found.

thanks for reading, have fun.
kk

notes.title: Update 02052019
notes.content:
hey, long time since last update. i have been working with other projects the time. i have learned some optimization methods with 3d modeling so those will come in.

- game built with latest unreal engine version 4.22
- alot polycount optimizations, every 3d asset has been opened again and optimized
- menu sound levels have been raised
- some menu sounds are played twice and those are fixed
- survivors field of view (FOV) is raised from 90 to 100

there will be smaller updates where things are tweaked  / possibly bugs fixed

notes.title: changes / volume / map
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31641821/d92b7c25e788cd40bbe7fa193b992a3255006abe.png[/img]

- fixed: survivor was able to vault after death
- players are slightly faster
- spectators have more freedom on flying
- volume slider added
- keypad system changed, no need to set the code manually anymore. press interact near pad and it will check your codes automatically. old keypad does not come to screen at all.
  (game has to have a nice flow, setting up the code manually kinda breaks it and can be very slow at times especially with controller.
    this will disable code ghosting via talking, everyone has to collect their own codes or go same time when door is open)
- code scrolls changed to papers
- map image with + sign has something little bonus
- new map: library

voice chat is disabled for now. proximity is the way it should have been done at start. you might see some bugs with volume slider.
